Author: Rayla Petal
Name: PoseKit
Description: Animation Assistance Plugin, offset your character's pose, save named presets and replay them, auto-discover Penumbra pose mods, and manually resync emote timing with a partner.
Punchline: Offset, save, and replay poses; auto-discover Penumbra animation mods.
Changelog:
- New: Bone Align remembers. Every successful Align is saved for the animation you're playing, and the next time you play that animation near your partner (or a targeted player, unpaired) PoseKit aligns you by itself with the same parts, gap and facing.
- Auto-align waits until both of you are actually playing the animation's loop (past the sit-down intro and any mod redraw), so it no longer aligns to the wrong position.
- The Bone Align section shows a Known animation panel with the remembered parts, what it's waiting for, and a Forget button. Self/Partner are filled in for you so you can re-align by hand.
- New Auto-align from memory setting (on by default). Auto-align never sends tells; with the SimpleHeels bridge on, only one of you moves.
- /posekit bones also logs animation timeline slots.
